papers.title: GeneEmbedLLM: Harnessing Large Language Models for Gene Functional Embedding and Association Prediction
papers.abstract: Effective and high-quality gene function representations are crucial for bioinformatics tasks. While biological knowledge about genes is inherently textual, encompassing functional descriptions and pathway annotations, current methods often rely on single-source, non-textual data, failing to capture the rich semantic information in multi-source gene annotations. In this paper, we propose GeneEmbedLLM, a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered framework for generating universal, semantically-aware gene embeddings. The proposed approach advances the gene representation learning through multi-source structured text integration from five authoritative databases and attribute-aware attention based on Longformer architecture and contrastive learning. Experimental results on diverse downstream tasks, ranging from molecular interactions and phenotypic dependencies to epigenetic regulation, confirm the validity and effectiveness of our proposed approach, where competitive performance is achieved across all evaluated benchmarks. We further validate the quality of the generated embeddings through comprehensive analyses, including embedding visualizations, intra-pathway similarity assessments, ablation study, and parameter analysis.

summary.takeaway: GeneEmbedLLM 利用大语言模型整合多源结构化基因文本注释，生成具有语义感知的通用基因嵌入。
summary.methods: 从五个权威数据库整合多源结构化文本，基于 Longformer 架构引入属性感知注意力，并结合对比学习训练嵌入；在分子互作、表型依赖和表观遗传调控等下游任务上评估，并做嵌入可视化、通路内相似度、消融和参数分析。
summary.relevance: 契合大语言模型与自监督/表示学习主题，展示 LLM 用于生物实体表示学习的路径。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在各项基准上取得有竞争力表现，未给出具体数值或对比方法细节，实际提升幅度需查看全文。

papers.title: π-SPECFormer: A Mass Spectrometry-based Foundation Model for Decoding the Dark Proteome
papers.abstract: In mass-spectrometry-based proteomics, a substantial proportion of acquired spectra remain unidentified, concealing a vast reservoir of biological variations commonly termed the "dark proteome", potentially obscuring sequence mutations, non-canonical peptides and post-translational modifications. Existing deep-learning methods largely rely on supervised training with peptide-spectrum matches (PSMs), limiting their ability to learn from the much larger pool of unannotated spectra. Here we introduce {pi}-SPECFormer, a mass-spectrometry foundation model pre-trained on 291 million spectra through a two-stage framework that combines self-supervised and PSMs-guided representation learning. {pi}-SPECFormer transfers effectively to de novo peptide sequencing, spectrum clustering and modification detection, consistently outperforming task-specific baselines. When applied to proteomic profiles from 103 individuals with lung adenocarcinoma, the model identified nine high-confidence mutated peptides, including six that were absent from the reference databases. {pi}-SPECFormer thus enables unbiased decoding of molecular complexity beyond the boundaries of the canonical proteome.

summary.takeaway: π-SPECFormer 是面向质谱蛋白质组学的基础模型，可从大量未注释谱图中学习并支持“暗蛋白质组”解码。
summary.methods: 在 2.91 亿张谱图上采用两阶段框架预训练，结合自监督学习与 PSM 引导的表示学习；迁移至 de novo 肽段测序、谱图聚类和修饰检测，并应用于 103 例肺腺癌个体的蛋白质组谱。
summary.relevance: 契合预训练与自监督/表示学习主题，且直接面向质谱蛋白质组学中的未注释数据问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告各任务的具体性能数值和基线细节；突变肽发现为初步应用结果，需独立验证。

papers.title: Transcriptome profiling reveals gene regulatory network governing seed size in Brassica napus
papers.abstract: Seed size is a critical trait influencing yield and quality in oilseed crops such as Brassica napus. Despite their economic importance, the genetic and molecular mechanisms regulating seed size remain unclear, particularly in polyploid species, such as B. napus. To deepen our understanding of seed size regulation, we performed a comprehensive transcriptomic analysis across four developmental stages (heart, torpedo, green, and mature) and three distinct seed organs: the seed coat, embryo, and endosperm. Differential expression analysis between B. napus var. Zhongshuang (ZS11) and B. napus cv. Ragged Jack (RJ) was performed to uncover regulatory networks involved in seed size control. Our results uncovered dynamic gene regulatory networks (GRNs) and pinpointed key regulators, including well-established factors like ABI5 and BRI1, as well as novel candidate genes such as KNAT5, ARF11, SUS2, UGT72B1, UGT89A2, and SBT1.7. The present research provides an understanding of the regulatory networks governing seed size in B. napus. These findings not only enhance our knowledge of seed biology but also offer valuable resources for future breeding strategies aimed at optimizing seed size and yield in polyploid oilseed crops.

summary.takeaway: 通过对甘蓝型油菜四个发育阶段和三种种子组织的转录组分析，构建种子大小调控的基因调控网络并提名关键调控因子。
summary.methods: 比较 ZS11 与 RJ 两个品种在 heart、torpedo、green、mature 四阶段及种皮、胚、胚乳三组织的差异表达，推断动态 GRN 并识别候选调控基因。
summary.relevance: 契合 GRN/Regulon 主题，提供多倍体作物种子大小调控网络资源。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明 GRN 推断的具体算法与验证方式；候选基因多为相关性提名，功能因果证据有限。

papers.title: Hierarchical organization in sparse gene regulatory networks shapes structural coherence and emergent regulatory coordination
papers.abstract: A fundamental challenge in systems biology is understanding how regulatory coordination is maintained within extremely sparse gene regulatory networks (GRNs). While traditional unsigned network metrics can quantify the overall magnitude of influence a specific node or edge exerts over the network, they cannot predict the functional direction and consistency of these regulatory changes. To address this gap, we introduce the coherence matrix. This topology-based framework for signed, directed GRNs computes a strictly bounded, interpretable measure of directional regulatory coordination between gene pairs. Using synthetic network ensembles, we demonstrate that architectures with low intrinsic structural coherence suffer severe density-driven scaling penalties. Such structures cannot scale without requiring biologically unrealistic edge densities. Applying this framework to six whole-organism GRNs reveals how biological topologies overcome these limitations. Whole-organism GRNs exhibit lower overall coherence and more fragmented structures than expected, avoiding rigid global co-regulation to maximize regulatory degrees of freedom. Furthermore, these systems resolve the scaling penalties of complex, low-coherence architectures by restricting dense regulatory crosstalk to a compact intermediate core. Modeling synthetic hierarchical networks confirms that this architecture, a compact core within a globally feed-forward scaffold, neutralizes scaling penalties by minimizing nodes requiring dense connectivity. This allows GRNs to efficiently route decisions despite extreme sparsity. Finally, validation with transcriptomic data confirms that coherence matrix accurately predicts empirical co-regulation directionality. By moving beyond unsigned connectivity, the structural coherence framework provides a quantitative tool to map how the intrinsic behavior of localized interactions scales into macroscopic, system-wide coordination.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于拓扑的 coherence matrix，用于量化有符号有向 GRN 中基因对之间的方向性调控协调，并揭示稀疏网络的分层核心结构。
summary.methods: 定义严格有界、可解释的方向协调度量；用合成网络集合分析结构一致性与密度缩放惩罚，应用于六个全生物体 GRN，并用转录组数据验证共调控方向预测。
summary.relevance: 契合 GRN/Regulon 主题，提供超越无符号连通性的网络结构分析框架。
summary.caveat: 主要基于合成网络与拓扑建模，生物学结论依赖所选六个全生物体 GRN 的代表性；摘要未给出验证的定量指标。

papers.title: mFrag: Integrating External DNA Methylation References Improves Lung Cancer Early Detection by Fragmentomics
papers.abstract: Fragmentomics analyzes features of circulating cell-free DNA fragments (e.g., fragment length or end motifs) derived from whole-genome sequencing of liquid biopsy samples (blood or other body fluids), enabling non-invasive early cancer detection. Here we present mFrag, a framework that integrates external methylation reference atlases with fragmentomic features for lung cancer detection. mFrag comprises two complementary methods: mFrag-Weight, which uses DNA methylation information to weight fragmentomic features, and mFrag-Net, which integrates fragmentomic features and external DNA methylation data through neural networks. We average the output probabilities of the two methods to obtain a final prediction score. The mFrag model was trained using 287 individuals at risk for lung cancer. In an independent case-control testing set comprising 385 non-cancer controls and 46 cancers (28 stage I, 12 stage II, and 6 stage III or IV), mFrag outperforms a DELFI-style fragmentomic approach, improving PR-AUC from 0.455 to 0.720 and sensitivity at 99% specificity from 0.043 to 0.478, with ROC-AUC from 0.871 to 0.908. For stage I lung cancer, mFrag raises PR-AUC from 0.314 to 0.558 and ROC-AUC from 0.855 to 0.894. Applied to end 4-mer motif features, mFrag likewise improved over an unweighted baseline, with gains contributed by both mFrag-Weight and mFrag-Net. In summary, mFrag improves the accuracy of fragmentomics-based lung cancer detection through integrating external DNA methylation data and the complementarity of its two component models, without incurring any additional data-generating cost.

summary.takeaway: mFrag 将外部 DNA 甲基化参考图谱与片段组学特征结合，提升肺癌早期检测性能。
summary.methods: 构建 mFrag-Weight（用甲基化信息加权片段组学特征）和 mFrag-Net（神经网络整合两类数据），平均二者输出；在 287 名肺癌风险个体上训练，在 385 例对照和 46 例癌症的独立集上测试。
summary.relevance: 契合检索增强与对齐主题，体现引入外部参考数据增强检测模型。
summary.caveat: 测试集癌症样本量较小（46 例，其中早期 40 例），结论需更大独立队列验证；甲基化参考与片段的整合方式细节需见全文。

papers.title: Decoupling Quantification and Identification for Label-Free Top-Down Proteomics Improves Proteome Coverage
papers.abstract: Quantifying proteoforms is essential for understanding biological processes. The most widely used quantification approach in top-down proteomics (TDP) is label-free quantification (LFQ), where quantification and identification compete for acquisition time. We identified missing values, insufficient fragmentation, and undersampling of low-abundance proteoforms as major factors limiting conventional TDP-LFQ workflows. Our proposed workflow decouples quantification and identification through MS1-only quantification followed by targeted data-dependent MS2 identification. The MS1-only acquisition more than doubled the number of mass features quantified reliably and improved quantification precision. Focusing targeted MS2 acquisition on significantly differentially abundant features enables optimization of MS2 parameters and increases identification coverage by 50%. The workflow was validated across different chromatographic conditions, MS acquisition setups, and sample preparation strategies. In Escherichia coli grown on glucose or acetate, the increased depth enabled by this workflow revealed biological insights inaccessible to a previously published bottom-up proteomics dataset. Overall, decoupling quantification and identification improves quantitative depth and proteoform coverage in TDP-LFQ and provides a flexible strategy for high-sensitivity and high-throughput proteoform quantification.

summary.takeaway: 提出将无标记自上而下蛋白质组学的定量与鉴定解耦：先 MS1 定量，再对差异特征做靶向 MS2 鉴定，以提高定量深度和蛋白质形式覆盖。
summary.methods: MS1-only 采集进行定量，随后针对显著差异丰度特征开展靶向数据依赖 MS2；在不同色谱条件、质谱采集设置和样品制备策略下验证，并应用于葡萄糖或乙酸培养的大肠杆菌。
summary.relevance: 契合检索增强与对齐主题中“先筛选再聚焦”的思路，属于蛋白质组学采集策略改进。
summary.caveat: 摘要称可靠定量质量特征数翻倍以上、鉴定覆盖提高 50%，但未给出统计细节和跨平台泛化边界。

papers.title: BioMeme: biological response memory for virtual cells
papers.abstract: Virtual cells predict responses to unmeasured perturbations, but neural models absorb measurements into weights, require retraining and cannot cite supporting experiments. Here we introduce biological response memory, replacing a learned state-to-response layer with a memory of measured experiments. BioMeme predicts next-dose responses in a new cell type from measured lower-dose states, recalling similarly responding compounds in that cell and the same compound in a reference cell line. Each prediction is an exact weighted sum of named measurements, and memory updates with one linear solve. In all nine preregistered comparisons across three screens, memory predicted response direction better than the learners it replaced. In U2OS, BioMeme outperformed input-matched ridge, adapted chemCPA and a neural layer in memory's place, and matched a full-panel network reading reference responses directly (error within 3.4%). Transfer was compound-specific, lowering error by 21.2% against at most 1.8% for wrong compounds, and replicated in reserved MCF7 data. With 20 references, fitting took seconds on one CPU thread, at least 420 times faster than neural tuning and fitting. Adding its prediction to one measured well cut that well's error by 27-31%. Biological response memory establishes a design principle for virtual cells any laboratory can update, inspect and run.

summary.takeaway: 这项研究聚焦于虚拟细胞。原文摘要要点：Virtual cells predict responses to unmeasured perturbations, but neural models absorb measurements into weights, require retraining and cannot cite supporting experiments. Here we introduce biological response memory, replacing a learned state-to-response layer with a memory of measured experiments.
summary.methods: 摘要中未识别出明确的方法标签
summary.relevance: 命中当前论文雷达的主题：虚拟细胞。

papers.title: Identifying a neurochemical signature of the paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus that predicts individual variability in cue-reward learning
papers.abstract: To investigate neurochemical factors that may confer vulnerability to psychiatric disorders, we used an animal model that captures a transdiagnostically relevant neurobehavioral endophenotype. During a Pavlovian conditioned approach paradigm, rats learn the predictive relationship between a lever cue and food reward. A subset of rats, sign trackers, also attribute incentive motivational value to the lever cue. Relative to non sign trackers, STs are more impulsive, have attentional deficits, and show greater reinstatement of drug seeking behavior. The paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus is a key neural node implicated in these individual differences. We combined in vivo microdialysis with liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry to quantify 22 neurobiologically relevant small molecules in the PVT before and 24 hours after Pavlovian training. Before training, glucose concentrations in the paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus were higher in rats subsequently classified as sign trackers than in non sign trackers and were correlated with the Pavlovian conditioned approach index used to phenotype the rats. Glucose concentrations decreased after training, and the magnitude of change differed between phenotypes. Multivariate regression identified baseline neurochemical profiles in the paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus associated with subsequent Pavlovian conditioned approach behavior. These findings identify a candidate PVT neurochemical signature that precedes behavioral phenotyping and may mark the propensity to sign track, providing insight into potential mechanisms underlying vulnerability to psychiatric disorders characterized by maladaptive cue motivated behavior.

summary.takeaway: 发现丘脑室旁核在巴甫洛夫训练前的神经化学特征（尤其葡萄糖水平）与个体提示-奖励学习表型相关。
summary.methods: 结合在体微透析与液相色谱-串联质谱，在训练前和训练后 24 小时定量大鼠 PVT 中 22 种神经生物学相关小分子，并用多变量回归关联后续巴甫洛夫条件化接近行为。
summary.relevance: 契合多智能体与奖励学习主题中关于个体差异和提示动机的研究。
summary.caveat: 为动物相关性研究，样本与因果机制有限；摘要未报告效应量、样本量和多重检验校正细节，不能据此推断人类精神疾病机制。

papers.title: Benchmarking foundation models for resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging time series in cognitive aging research
papers.abstract: Foundation models trained on large neuroimaging datasets could help smaller studies investigate cognition from brain recordings. However, whether the foundation model-derived representations improve assessment of current cognition, prediction of follow-up cognition, or characterization of cognitive change remains unclear. We evaluated nine configurations from five model families that process regional resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging time series, using 3,103 scans from 1,653 participants across two observational and five intervention aging cohorts. Primary frozen representations showed no consistent superiority over conventional functional connectivity for concurrent cognitive associations or diagnostic classification. Changing the readout improved selected concurrent cognitive associations without updating model weights, indicating that performance depended partly on how representations were extracted. Additional post-training and embedding alignment yielded gains in selected settings but did not consistently improve performance across outcomes. In the primary longitudinal analyses, imaging representations did not establish added value beyond baseline clinical measures. These findings show that readout choice influences concurrent cognitive associations, while the added value of these representations for longitudinal outcomes remains unestablished.

summary.takeaway: 系统评测发现，静息态fMRI基础模型表示对认知关联与诊断分类并不稳定优于传统功能连接；改变readout可改善部分同期关联，但对纵向认知结局的增量价值尚未确立。
summary.methods: 评测5个模型家族的9种配置，使用两个观察性队列和五个干预性衰老队列共3,103次扫描（1,653名参与者）；比较冻结表示与传统功能连接，并考察readout替换、后训练与嵌入对齐的影响。
summary.relevance: 该文直接检验预训练基础模型在fMRI时间序列上的迁移价值，与“预训练”主题相关，并为小样本神经影像研究采用基础模型提供基准证据。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体效应量或统计细节；主要结论为“无一致优势”和“纵向增量未确立”，readout与后训练的收益仅见于部分设定，不能推广为普遍提升。

papers.title: A tabular foundation model rivals established species distribution models from presence-only records
papers.abstract: Predicting where something occurs from records of where it has been observed, without reliable records of absence, is a common problem in science. Species distribution models (SDMs) such as MaxEnt address it in fields from biological conservation and climate-change assessment to the mapping of disease vectors and archaeological sites, but must be tuned for each dataset. Tabular foundation models, pre-trained on synthetic prediction tasks, predict new datasets without per-dataset training. Only one study has tested them as SDMs, and it fine-tuned on survey data from the evaluated regions. We evaluated tabular foundation models on the standard SDM benchmark (225 species in six regions, with independent presence-absence surveys), under the protocol used to compare 21 methods, and on 120 virtual species with known distributions. Without tuning, a tabular foundation model, TabPFN 3.5, equalled the best published approach, a five-model ensemble (mean AUC 0.732). Fine-tuned on presence-background tasks from other regions, it became the best single model on the benchmark (0.736), outperformed MaxEnt (0.728) and boosted regression trees after correction for multiple comparisons, and was better calibrated than MaxEnt, although six regions were too few to establish the advantage for new regions. Fine-tuning on presence-absence surveys of other species helped only when they came from the evaluated regions. On virtual species, it recovered simple additive relationships less well than regression-based methods but complex ones at least as well when records were unbiased, and was worse with environmentally biased records. Tabular foundation models are competitive SDMs without per-dataset tuning, but they are sensitive to environmentally biased records.

summary.takeaway: 表格基础模型TabPFN 3.5在无需按数据集调参的情况下达到与最佳已发表物种分布模型集成相当的性能，微调后可成为基准上最佳单模型，但对环境偏倚记录敏感。
summary.methods: 在标准SDM基准（6个区域225个物种，含独立 presence-absence 调查）及120个已知分布的虚拟物种上评测；对比MaxEnt、提升回归树及21种方法的比较协议，并测试跨区域presence-background微调。
summary.relevance: 该文将预训练表格基础模型用于 presence-only 分布预测，与“预训练”主题直接相关，展示基础模型在生态学预测任务中的免调参迁移潜力。
summary.caveat: 仅6个区域，作者明确指出不足以确立对新区域的泛化优势；对虚拟物种的简单加性关系恢复不如回归方法，且环境偏倚记录下表现更差。

papers.title: Homology-aware average nucleotide identity estimation at scale with TurboANI
papers.abstract: Here we introduce TurboANI, a fast homology-aware average nucleotide identity (ANI) estimation algorithm that implements the seed-chain-quasi-alignment scheme using SIMD seeding, compact indexing, lightweight chaining, and cache-friendly bitset sliding minwise hashing, achieving up to ~40,000-fold speedup over the alignment-based ANI algorithm with near-perfect agreement. TurboANI is also >40-fold faster than the state-of-the-art FastANI and ten-fold faster than skani while maintaining better accuracy. In the sensitive mode, it has a ten-fold higher true-ANI recovery rate than skani.

summary.takeaway: TurboANI提出基于seed-chain-quasi-alignment的快速同源感知ANI估计算法，在大幅加速的同时保持或提升准确率。
summary.methods: 采用SIMD种子、紧凑索引、轻量级链化和缓存友好的bitset滑动minwise哈希；与基于比对的ANI算法、FastANI和skani比较速度与准确性，并设敏感模式。
summary.relevance: 该方法涉及序列检索、种子链化与对齐式比较，与“检索增强与对齐”主题在算法层面相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告相对加速倍数与一致性/准确率定性结论，未说明测试数据集规模、物种范围或内存占用；约40,000倍加速是相对于比对式ANI，需注意比较基线。

papers.title: Visual capture of the head-direction signal in a rat model of Fragile X Syndrome
papers.abstract: Fragile X Syndrome (FXS) is a common inherited monogenic cause of autism spectrum disorder and intellectual disability (ASD/ID), conditions frequently associated with altered sensory processing and multisensory integration. However, the circuit mechanisms underlying these alterations remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the integration of visual and self-motion information in the head-direction (HD) system in a rat model of FXS (Fmr1-/y rats). Using high-density silicon probes, we recorded neuronal activity in the postsubiculum (PoSub), a cortical hub of the HD system, while adult Fmr1-/y and wild-type (WT) rats experienced repeated rotations of a visual landmark. In WT rats, the HD signal only partially followed landmark rotations, consistent with weighted integration of visual and self-motion information, and visual landmark control progressively weakened across repeated cue conflicts. In contrast, the HD signal in Fmr1-/y rats closely followed landmark rotations and failed to show experience-dependent recalibration. This enhanced visual capture was accompanied by reduced angular head velocity tuning in PoSub neurons, indicating weakened representation of self-motion information. Together, these findings reveal an altered balance between visual and self-motion inputs to the HD system in a rat model of FXS and identify a possible circuit-level mechanism through which sensory integration of vision and self-motion may be disrupted in ASD/ID.

summary.takeaway: 在Fmr1-/y大鼠模型中，头方向信号对视觉地标的跟随增强且缺乏经验依赖的重校准，伴随PoSub神经元角速度调谐减弱，提示视觉与自运动信息整合失衡。
summary.methods: 用高密度硅探针记录成年Fmr1-/y与野生型大鼠后下托（PoSub）神经元活动，在重复视觉地标旋转及线索冲突条件下比较头方向信号。
summary.relevance: 该文研究感觉信息整合与神经表征重校准，与“检索增强与对齐”主题仅在多感觉整合/对齐的概念层面相关，并非计算检索方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要为动物模型机制研究，样本量与统计细节未给出；所提ASD/ID机制为可能解释，不能直接推及人类临床结论。

papers.title: MELD: Mutation Effect Learning through Differential embeddings
papers.abstract: We introduce MELD (Mutation Effect Learning through Differential Embeddings), a compact model for predicting the functional consequences of single nucleotide variants (SNVs) by training directly on the wild-type (WT) versus mutant differential. Interpreting SNVs is central to clinical genomics, yet experimental characterization cannot scale to millions of observed variants. Leading sequence-to-function models (Enformer, Borzoi, AlphaGenome) are trained on absolute genomic tracks and score variants post hoc through in-silico mutagenesis (ISM), so the WT-mutant difference never enters the training loss. MELD instead places the logit difference {Delta}z = zmut - zwt inside the supervised objective. It combines a shared CNN-Transformer encoder, a mutant-specific mutation-mask boost, multiscale mutation-centered pooling, and a learned adaptive amplification factor . On ClinVar (1.57M variants), MELD (1.9M parameters) reached an AUROC of 0.986 versus 0.800 for a same-data, same-backbone ISM baseline, with ablations confirming the contribution of each component. On a shared benchmark, it outperformed frozen foundation models with 3-1,300x more parameters (AUROC 0.967 vs. 0.924 for AlphaGenome and 0.936 for Nucleotide Transformer). With only 50, 000 training variants, it exceeded the ISM baseline trained on all 1.48M (AUROC 0.903 vs. 0.796) variants. On BRCA1 saturation genome editing, frozen MELD achieved a Spearman {rho} of 0.42, above Borzoi (0.40), and ClinVar transfer raised it to 0.45. These results demonstrate that direct differential supervision is a compact, data-efficient alternative to post-hoc ISM scoring with substantially larger pretrained models.

papers.title: Human medial frontal neurons represent integrated semantic content and sensory evidence to inform decision-making
papers.abstract: Humans can reconfigure how they act on the world from a single verbal instruction. Central to this capacity is the ability to represent what an instruction specifies and to bring that content to bear on incoming sensory evidence. However, little is known about where in the human brain instruction content is encoded, how it combines with sensory evidence to produce a choice, and how this integration relates to behavior. Here, we characterized single-neuron and population responses recorded in the ventral temporal cortex, medial temporal lobe, medial frontal cortex and ventromedial prefrontal cortex of neurosurgical patients performing a verbal instruction task. On each trial, a written instruction specified which stimulus feature was relevant and whether the correct response was to choose or to reject the stimulus that best matched it, so that the same image pair required opposite responses under different instructions. Only medial frontal populations jointly encoded the instructed task, and the target feature, whereas ventral temporal populations encoded stimulus features along axes that generalized across instruction conditions. Choice representation emerged first in ventromedial prefrontal and then in medial frontal cortex during stimulus presentation, before a motor response could be prepared. Shuffling instruction content selectively degraded prediction of medial frontal population activity, whereas shuffling stimulus identity selectively degraded ventral temporal activity. To ask how these representations could be computed, we trained a vision-language model with separable visual and linguistic streams converging on a recurrent decision module to perform the same task. Its visual embeddings predicted held-out ventral temporal activity and its recurrent activations revealed a task solution space that predicted medial frontal activity, and the strength of this alignment tracked behavioral accuracy. These results identify a cortical hierarchy in which medial frontal circuitry represents the content of verbal goals and acts on a ventral temporal substrate whose representational axes remain stable, and indicate that functional hierarchies discovered in artificial networks can serve as predictive models of human neural circuitry.

summary.takeaway: 人类内侧额叶群体联合编码指令任务与目标特征并整合感觉证据，而腹侧颞叶沿跨指令稳定的轴编码刺激特征；视觉语言模型的可分离表征可预测这一层级活动。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Personalised Gene Expression Prediction Improves Cell-Type-Specific Association Testing
papers.abstract: Linking genetic variation to disease requires accurate prediction of its effects on gene expression in relevant cell types. Sequence-to-function models offer a way to predict these effects and, with training on personal genomes, have begun to capture inter-individual expression differences. However, effect sign accuracy remains limited, and predictive uncertainty is unquantified. Here we introduce ATTICUS, which combines personalised sequence representations with uncertainty-aware expression prediction. ATTICUS transfers regulatory information learned in bulk expression pretraining to cell-type-specific expression prediction without requiring genotypes paired with single-cell expression data. Across blood and brain cell types in OneK1K and ROSMAP, ATTICUS approximately doubles expression prediction correlations relative to scPrediXcan and substantially improves sign accuracy. Moreover, ATTICUS enables uncertainty-aware transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS). Applied to systemic lupus erythematosus and Alzheimer's disease, ATTICUS identifies more associations, with greater cell-type specificity and stronger directional concordance, and reduced statistical inflation. Together, our results demonstrate that personalised training makes predictions more directionally consistent, and uncertainty propagation improves the calibration of TWAS and the prioritisation of disease genes. ATTICUS provides a framework for both, enabling the use of single-cell expression datasets without matched genotypes to inform uncertainty-aware TWAS, expanding their use in prioritising disease-associated genes and cell types.

summary.takeaway: ATTICUS结合个性化序列表示与不确定性感知表达预测，在无需基因型匹配单细胞数据的情况下提升细胞类型特异表达预测及TWAS校准与疾病基因优先级。
summary.methods: 将bulk表达预训练学到的调控信息迁移到细胞类型特异表达预测；在OneK1K与ROSMAP的血液和脑细胞类型上评测，并应用于SLE与阿尔茨海默病的TWAS。
summary.relevance: 该方法依赖bulk表达预训练并迁移至单细胞场景，与“预训练”主题相关，同时涉及不确定性传播与疾病关联检验。
summary.caveat: 摘要称表达预测相关性约翻倍、符号准确率提升，但未给出具体数值与置信区间；TWAS发现更多关联不等同于因果基因确定，且需独立队列验证。

papers.title: Accelerating discovery and integration from RNA to Protein with R2T2P
papers.abstract: Integrating transcriptomics and proteomics data remains an unmet challenge in the post-genomics era, discouraging researchers from pursuing integrative approaches to molecular biology research. Leveraging the power of translation profiling, we present RNA to Translation to Protein (R2T2P), a computational platform integrating genome-guided transcriptome assembly with identification of translation and proteins, including a tailored differential analysis framework and support for multiple reference transcriptomes. We applied R2T2P to investigate a cellular model of facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), where ectopic expression of the DUX4 retrogene in skeletal muscle triggers significant alterations in transcription and RNA metabolism. We uncovered hundreds of uncharacterized, highly overexpressed RNAs, including antisense and alternative transcripts, and quantified their contribution to translatome and proteome. Re-analysis of expression datasets from patient-derived myotubes and muscle biopsies validated this alternative transcriptome in FSHD patients, adding a reservoir of bona-fide novel molecular actors in a rare disease. Available at https://github.com/nfdata-omics/R2T2P/, R2T2P is a flexible and powerful workflow in modern integrative biology.

summary.takeaway: 提出 R2T2P 计算平台，将转录组组装与翻译、蛋白鉴定整合，用于从 RNA 到翻译再到蛋白的联合分析；在 FSHD 细胞模型中揭示大量未表征 RNA 及其对翻译组和蛋白组的贡献。
summary.methods: 整合基因组引导的转录组组装、翻译 profiling 与蛋白鉴定，配有差异分析框架并支持多个参考转录组；应用于 FSHD 细胞模型，并重分析患者来源肌管和肌肉活检数据。
summary.relevance: 与“检索增强与对齐”主题相关，因其核心在于多组学数据（转录、翻译、蛋白）的整合与对齐，而非仅依赖单一模态。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出平台相对已有整合工具的定量比较或基准评测；FSHD 发现主要来自重分析验证，未说明实验验证的规模与因果证据。

papers.title: Integrated Transcriptomic and Translatomic Profiling Reveals Noncanonical RNA Junctions and Hidden Coding Potential in Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea Virus
papers.abstract: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) poses a major threat to the global swine industry. Although coronavirus discontinuous transcription is well characterized, the classical model cannot fully explain the diversity of viral RNA junctions, while conventional genome annotations may underestimate viral protein-coding capacity. To address these gaps, we integrated time-resolved RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), cycloheximide (CHX)- and harringtonine (HAR)-treated ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq), comparative genomics, and peptide mass spectrometry to investigate PEDV RNA expression and hidden coding potential. RNA-seq revealed that, at 3 hours post-infection (hpi), the 3 genomic region exhibited strong relative coverage enrichment, whereas the relative contribution of the 5 replicase-coding region increased rapidly between 3 and 5 hpi, suggesting a possible transition from sgRNA-dominated RNA accumulation toward enhanced genomic RNA replication. Genome-wide junction analysis identified 43,635 distinct noncanonical RNA junctions, although canonical sgRNA junctions accounted for 95.5% of all junction-supporting reads. Several abundant noncanonical sgRNAs were predicted to generate novel coding products, including N-x4, N-x2, M-x3, and M-x2, short peptides encoded within the 3 untranslated region (UTR), and two distinct N-terminally truncated S proteins, thereby expanding the potential coding repertoire of PEDV. Genome-wide reading-frame analysis uncovered a pronounced asymmetry in hidden coding potential, identifying 68 overlapping open reading frames (ORFs) longer than 40 amino acids in the +1 reading frame, compared with only three in the +2 frame. Ribo-seq further revealed a progressive redistribution of viral ribosome occupancy toward structural protein-coding regions during the later stages of infection. By integrating HAR-associated translation initiation-site enrichment with CHX-based ORF-level translation analysis, we identified several noncanonical ORFs with strong translation-associated evidence, including N-x1, N-x2, S-x1, and ORF1b-x13. Moreover, peptide mass spectrometry detected a characteristic peptide corresponding to N-x1 in infected samples, providing independent proteomic evidence for the expression of this previously unannotated viral protein. Together, these findings uncover extensive noncanonical RNA synthesis and hidden protein-coding capacity in PEDV, establishing a foundation for understanding novel viral gene expression strategies and their potential evolutionary and pathogenic significance.

summary.takeaway: 整合时序 RNA-seq、Ribo-seq、比较基因组学与肽质量谱，揭示 PEDV 存在大量非经典 RNA 连接和隐藏编码潜力，包括 3'UTR 小肽、截短 S 蛋白及新 ORF。
summary.methods: 感染后时间分辨 RNA-seq；CHX 与 harringtonine 处理的核糖体 profiling；全基因组连接与阅读框分析；比较基因组学；肽质量谱验证。
summary.relevance: 与“检索增强与对齐”相关，体现在对 RNA 连接、读段支持度、阅读框与核糖体足迹的多层证据对齐和整合分析。
summary.caveat: 非经典连接多数支持读段比例低，仅少数有翻译或质谱证据；新 ORF 的功能与致病意义未在摘要中确立，需进一步实验验证。

papers.title: Host control and regulation of human anellovirus persistence
papers.abstract: Anelloviruses are the most abundant and diverse eukaryotic viruses known to infect humans and can persist throughout our lifetimes. Despite their ubiquity, the host factors governing their physiologic distribution and abundance remain poorly understood. Here, we construct a viral pangenome of 2,023 strains to quantify anellovirus DNA in >1.1 million participants spanning three genetic biobanks. Genome-wide association studies identify 121 loci linked to viral persistence, predominantly via immune regulation by NF-kB signaling. Further, we associate variable anellovirus detection with conditions characterized by immune dysfunction, including lymphoid malignancies. By screening 3.2 petabases of human single-cell sequencing data, we identify myeloid progenitors in the bone marrow as a prominent site of anellovirus transcription in vivo. Finally, Perturb-seq of anellovirus proteins reveals that anellovirus ORF2, particularly from Alphatorquevirus, attenuates TNF-a-induced NF-kB signaling, connecting host genetic variation, cellular context, and viral immunomodulation to characterize the persistence of the eukaryotic human virome's most abundant component.

summary.takeaway: 基于 2,023 株病毒泛基因组和超百万参与者，鉴定 121 个与 anellovirus 持续感染相关位点（主要涉及 NF-kB 免疫调控），并将骨髓髓系祖细胞定位为体内转录主要部位；ORF2 可减弱 TNF-a 诱导的 NF-kB 信号。
summary.methods: 构建病毒泛基因组，在三个生物样本库中定量病毒 DNA 并做 GWAS；筛查 3.2 petabases 单细胞测序数据定位转录部位；对病毒蛋白进行 Perturb-seq。
summary.relevance: 与“单细胞扰动”主题直接相关，因使用 Perturb-seq 解析病毒蛋白对宿主信号通路的扰动效应，并结合单细胞数据定位细胞类型。
summary.caveat: GWAS 关联为相关性，宿主遗传变异与病毒持续性的因果方向未在摘要中确定；Perturb-seq 为体外扰动，体内生理意义需进一步验证。

papers.title: COTree: A Statistical Framework for Deciphering Cell-Resolved Multi-Omics Trajectories
papers.abstract: Recent advances in whole-cell modeling enable the computational tracking of the temporal evolution of thousands of molecular species across genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic layers. These models provide a complementary perspective for studying cellular dynamics, offering continuous, system-wide observations that are difficult to obtain from experimental technologies, which are often destructive and yield only static measurements from limited modalities. While whole-cell models generate multi-omic simulation trajectories with high temporal resolution, analyzing and interpreting such complex data remains a major challenge that limits their potential to elucidate cellular dynamics. To address this challenge, we propose COTree, a statistical framework that learns integrated multi-omic representations and constructs a trajectory principal tree to summarize cellular progression patterns. COTree enables a broad range of downstream analyses, including cell classification, fate prediction, developmental time detection, and driver species identification, that provide new insights into how cells develop and differentiate. To demonstrate its practical utility, we apply COTree to a multi-omic trajectory dataset generated from the whole-cell model of JCVI-Syn3A, revealing cell types, characterizing long-term cellular dynamics, and identifying key driver species associated with cell death and replication.

summary.takeaway: 提出 COTree 统计框架，学习多组学整合表示并构建轨迹主树，用于概括全细胞模型产生的细胞动态轨迹，支持细胞分类、命运预测、发育时间检测和驱动物种识别。
summary.methods: 从全细胞模型生成的多组学高时间分辨率模拟轨迹中学习整合表示，构建轨迹主树；在 JCVI-Syn3A 全细胞模型数据上演示。
summary.relevance: 与“虚拟细胞”主题直接相关，因其分析对象正是全细胞模型产生的模拟多组学轨迹，服务于虚拟细胞动态的解读。
summary.caveat: 方法仅在 JCVI-Syn3A 单一全细胞模型数据上展示，向更复杂细胞或真实实验数据的泛化性未在摘要中评估；驱动物种识别为统计关联，非因果验证。

papers.title: phyB photobodies display molecular memory, regulating light signaling transcriptional states through phase separation.
papers.abstract: Phytochrome B is a crucial red and far-red light sensor, which controls plant development and environmental responses to light and temperature. In the nucleus, phyB forms phase separated condensates, also called photobodies, consisting of various transcriptional regulators and transcription factors. phyB photobodies can form or disperse depending on the amount of light, the light quality, or ambient temperature. However, the biological relevance for forming photobodies is still unclear. In recent years the study of condensates has given rise to the idea that condensates can act as molecular memory, either due to long equilibration timescales arising from strong interactions that can kinetically trap a mixture in a phase-separated state beyond the equilibrium coexistence line, or from phase-separation dependent modification processes or transcriptional regulation. Here, we hypothesize that the formation of phyB photobodies and the associated sequestration of signaling molecules allows for the formation of cell-type specific memory about light conditions. To address this hypothesis, we first developed a live imaging setup of phyB photobodies which shows that they do not follow classic liquid-liquid phase separation dynamics, but instead have a restriction on their size, intensity and minimum number. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (FRAP) then showed that photobodies between cell types have different levels of mobilities and diffusivities, suggesting that they are more stable in darkness or high red light, versus low red light. These differences in phyB photobody stability between cell types were also confirmed through whole-mount confocal imaging and single-nucleus transcriptomics in the same light-perturbation series. Through sci-Seq single nucleus spatial transcriptomics of the cotyledon in this light perturbation series, we identify a photobody-associated transcriptional cluster of nuclei that regulates photosynthesis, circadian rhythm, and RNA processing; the phyB photobody likely promotes its own stability by regulating TZP expression. The correlation between photobodies and transcriptional regulation shows how phyB condensates can provide cell-type specific light responses and exhibit signaling memory in changing environmental conditions.

summary.takeaway: 结合活体成像、FRAP 与单核空间转录组，提出 phyB 光小体具有分子记忆，其稳定性因细胞类型和光条件而异，并与调控光合作用、昼夜节律和 RNA 加工的转录簇相关。
summary.methods: phyB 光小体活体成像与 FRAP 测量迁移率和扩散系数；全装共聚焦成像；同一光扰动序列下的 sci-Seq 单核空间转录组。
summary.relevance: 与“GRN / Regulon”主题相关，因识别光小体相关的转录调控簇，并提出 phyB 可能通过调控 TZP 表达维持自身稳定性，涉及基因调控网络。
summary.caveat: phyB 通过 TZP 促进自身稳定性为推测性机制，摘要未提供直接因果实验；分子记忆概念主要基于相关性和稳定性差异，需功能扰动验证。

papers.title: Evaluation effects can rival reported concordance gains in cross-cancer survival prediction
papers.abstract: Studies of cross-cancer learning for survival prediction from tumour omics have reported concordance gains of 0.020 and 0.045, but how such gains compare with evaluation effects remains unclear. We examined these effects across 13 TCGA cancers (5,761 patients, 1,526 disease-specific deaths), using five repeats of five-fold cross-validation and paired bootstrap intervals. When model selection did not use test data, our borrowing model gained 0.009 (95% interval 0.001 to 0.016) over its target-fitted reference when cancers received equal weight (post hoc). Random-effects pooling gave a gain of 0.002 (-0.002 to 0.006), with most weight assigned to cancers where the model made little use of the pretrained score. Choosing the fusion weight on test splits raised the apparent equal-weight gain to 0.017. We reimplemented a published method, VAECox, which showed no pretraining gain over random initialisation at the last or validation-selected training step. Choosing each network's best test step, as the published code does, raised concordance by 0.03 to 0.05 across the 13-cancer and ten-cancer overall-survival settings, but barely changed the difference between networks. In a constructed post hoc experiment, choosing the best test step only for the pretrained network changed the equal-weight mean difference from -0.004 to +0.045 (+0.035 to +0.054). Across seven multi-omics comparisons, estimates from single five-fold runs differed from their cancer's five-run mean by at least 0.02 in 11% to 42% of runs. Concordance was about 0.02 lower at held-out tissue source sites. Interpreting a reported gain therefore requires each model's selection rule, variation across repeated partitions, the weighting of cancers and the evaluation population.

summary.takeaway: 指出跨癌种生存预测中报告的一致性增益（0.020、0.045）可与评估效应相当；模型选择规则、重复分区变异、癌种加权和评估人群会显著影响结论。
summary.methods: 在 13 个 TCGA 癌种（5,761 患者，1,526 例疾病特异性死亡）上采用五次五折交叉验证和配对 bootstrap 区间；重实现 VAECox；多项事后与多组学比较分析。
summary.relevance: 与“预训练”主题相关，因其检验预训练模型在跨癌种迁移中是否带来真实增益，并揭示评估流程如何夸大或掩盖预训练收益。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的多为事后分析和特定数据集结果，未给出统一推荐流程；作者也强调需结合选择规则、重复变异、加权和评估人群解读，结论不宜直接外推到其他任务。

papers.title: High-throughput identification of chromatin-opening transcription factors
papers.abstract: Cell fate transitions involve major changes to the chromatin landscape, some of which are thought to deepen the basin around a newly adopted cell state, stabilizing gene expression programs that might otherwise be transient. Transcription factors (TFs) are central to this process, binding only a subset of the genome-wide occurrences of their cognate motifs to create accessible regions that can act as cell type-specific enhancers. However, apart from a few well-studied cases, it is not clear which of the ~1,600 mammalian TFs can directly or indirectly initiate newly accessible sites, nor why only some motif occurrences gain accessibility. Here, we performed pooled CRISPR activation (CRISPRa) screens to upregulate endogenous developmental TFs in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs) and assess their impact on the chromatin landscape. Following a pre-screen of 240 developmental TFs for their capacity to elicit strong changes to the transcriptome, we prioritized 60 TFs for a well-powered CRISPRa multiome screen in which we jointly profiled gene expression and chromatin accessibility across ~140,000 single cells. We identify TFs that appear to initiate new chromatin accessibility on their own ("autonomous"), others whose chromatin-opening activity appears dependent on coincident binding of co-TFs heterogeneously expressed across mESCs ("opportunistic"), and yet others which appear to induce a co-TF and then act alongside it ("hierarchical"). Taken together, our findings suggest that the ability of a TF to "pioneer" chromatin opening, when it is newly expressed at physiological levels, strongly depends on the cell state and gene regulatory network it lands in. Looking forward, a comprehensive charting of such dependencies will inform how cell fate transitions are initiated in development, homeostasis and disease, and how to engineer them in silico, in vitro and in vivo.

summary.takeaway: 通过 CRISPRa 多组学筛选鉴定可启动染色质开放的转录因子，并将其分为自主型、机会型和层级型，表明 TF 的“先锋”能力强烈依赖所处细胞状态和基因调控网络。
summary.methods: 先对 240 个发育相关 TF 做 CRISPRa 预筛，再对 60 个 TF 开展多组学 CRISPRa 筛选，联合分析约 14 万个单细胞的基因表达和染色质可及性；在 mESC 中进行。
summary.relevance: 与“GRN / Regulon”主题直接相关，因研究 TF 如何在特定基因调控网络背景下重塑染色质可及性和转录程序。
summary.caveat: 筛选局限于小鼠胚胎干细胞和发育相关 TF 子集，向其他细胞类型和约 1,600 个哺乳动物 TF 的推广性有限；分类基于表型关联，直接与间接机制未完全区分。

papers.title: The GhOFP1-GhTALE-GhXTHB transcriptional cascade regulates vascular cambium development in cotton stems.
papers.abstract: The temporally regulated morphogenesis of plant organs depends on the precise differentiation of meristematic stem cells. This process is driven by the coordinated dynamics of specific stem cell populations in apical and lateral meristems, which mediate longitudinal elongation and radial thickening, respectively. Although considerable progress has been made in elucidating apical meristem-mediated longitudinal growth, the spatiotemporal mechanisms governing radial growth through the vascular cambium remain incompletely understood. Here, we generated high-resolution single-cell transcriptomic profiles of stem tissues from the cotton cultivar ZM24. Gene regulatory network analysis identified GhXTHB, which was highly expressed in the vascular cambium. Overexpression (OE) of GhXTHB reduced the number of vascular cambial cell layers and xylem width compared with the wild type, whereas CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout (KO) of GhXTHB increased the number of cambium cell layers without affecting xylem width. We further identified GhTALE as an upstream regulator of GhXTHB; OE of GhTALE promoted cambium cell proliferation and increased the number of cambial layers. By contrast, knockout of GhTALE (KO-GhTALE) reduced both cambial proliferation and xylem width. Notably, GhXTHB expression was upregulated in GhTALE-edited lines, indicating that GhTALE negatively regulates GhXTHB. Further analysis revealed that GhTALE physically interacts with GhOFP1, and KO of GhOFP1 increased the number of vascular cambium cell layers. Mechanistically, GhOFP1 is recruited to the GhXTHB promoter through its interaction with GhTALE, thereby modulating vascular cambium development. These findings identify the GhOFP1-GhTALE-GhXTHB module as a regulatory cascade controlling vascular cambium proliferation in cotton stems, providing new insights into the transcriptional control of stem architecture and biomass accumulation.

summary.takeaway: 利用棉花茎单细胞转录组鉴定 GhOFP1-GhTALE-GhXTHB 调控级联，揭示其控制血管形成层增殖，为茎结构和生物量积累的转录调控提供新见解。
summary.methods: 对棉花品种 ZM24 茎组织进行高分辨率单细胞转录组和基因调控网络分析；结合过表达与 CRISPR-Cas9 敲除实验验证 GhXTHB、GhTALE、GhOFP1 的功能及相互作用。
summary.relevance: 与“GRN / Regulon”主题直接相关，因通过单细胞数据和遗传扰动构建并验证了调控血管形成层发育的转录级联。
summary.caveat: 研究限于棉花 ZM24 品种，其他物种或品种的保守性未在摘要中说明；摘要未展示 GhOFP1-GhTALE-GhXTHB 模块对最终生物量的直接田间证据。

papers.title: Inference of cell division parameters in bacteria under transient growth conditions
papers.abstract: Most quantitative models of bacterial cell division assume steady-state growth, yet natural environments are highly dynamic. Here, we infer division control parameters of E. coli from single-cell size trajectories under nonsteady growth. We describe growth as a continuous process interrupted by stochastic divisions, whose propensity depends on cell size and on the size added since birth. Combining an estimation of time-dependent single-cell growth rates with a maximum-likelihood estimator that we previously validated on synthetic data, we obtain time-resolved estimates of the mean added size at division, its noise, and a strategy parameter that measures how added size depends on birth size. This parameter vanishes for the adder, in which cells add, on average, a fixed size regardless of their size at birth, and is negative for sizer-adder control, in which larger-born cells add less size. We apply this approach to published single-cell data covering steady exponential growth, gradual nutrient depletion, and exit from starvation. We implement a time-resolved model selection based on the Akaike information criterion, concluding that the adder is sufficient during steady growth, whereas size dynamics during entry into and exit from stationary phase are better explained by transient deviations toward sizer-adder control. The framework provides a general method to quantify time-resolved changes in the scale, stochasticity, and strategy of division in nonsteady environments.

summary.takeaway: 提出在非稳态生长条件下推断大肠杆菌分裂控制参数的方法，发现稳态生长中adder策略已足够，而进入与退出稳定期时瞬时偏向sizer-adder控制。
summary.methods: 结合单细胞生长速率估计与在合成数据上验证过的最大似然估计器，从已发表的单细胞尺寸轨迹推断分裂时平均增加尺寸、其噪声及策略参数，并用基于AIC的时间分辨模型选择比较adder与sizer-adder。
summary.relevance: 摘要中没有提及检索增强或对齐相关内容，与给定主题关联不明确。
summary.caveat: 仅基于摘要无法评估估计器在真实数据上的稳健性；结论依赖已发表单细胞数据集，且策略判别基于模型比较而非直接机制验证。

papers.title: Multi-Enzyme Data-Independent Acquisition Mass Spectrometry for Proteoform-Aware Single-shot Proteomics
papers.abstract: Biological regulation does not operate at the level of the protein but across ensembles of protein variants shaped by alternative splicing, post-translational modification and endogenous proteolytic processing. Yet most conventional bottom-up discovery proteomics workflows remain optimized for a canonical protein census, leaving much of the sequence-level variation invisible. Multi-enzyme digestion has been recognized as an effective strategy to expand sequence coverage and proteoform sensitivity, but existing implementations rely on resource-heavy per-enzyme liquid chromatography coupled to mass spectrometry (LC-MS) analysis, dedicated measurements for spectral library construction, and semi-manual reconciliation across multiple software tools, restricting the use to specialized laboratories and limited sample cohorts. Here we introduce mE-DIA, a multi-enzyme, proteoform-resolved data independent acquisition (DIA)-MS workflow that multiplexes complementary protease digested samples into a single DIA injection and processes them through a library-free pipeline within a single analysis engine, without supplemental data dependent acquisition (DDA)-MS measurements. The mE-DIA Pipeline graphical user interface orchestrates the analysis, and a dedicated proteoform inference algorithm and the interactive mE-DIA Peptide Mapper viewer make the sequence-level evidence explorable. Comparing the workflow to prevailing DDA-library-based multi-enzyme DIA on the same raw data and within shared search space showed increased identified protein groups by 30 % and protein groups quantified at [≤] 20 % CV by 47 %. A three-enzyme multiplex of the human pathogen Streptococcus pyogenes resolved 990 protein-backbone variants among 309 canonical protein entries, 1.8-fold more than the most productive single-enzyme analysis, including an H69 C-terminal proteoform of the ribosomal protein uS19 that the trypsin-only workflow did not resolve. By consolidating multi-enzyme acquisition, analysis and proteoform interpretation into one accessible toolset, mE-DIA brings sub-gene-resolved evidence within reach of routine single-shot discovery DIA proteomics.

summary.takeaway: 提出mE-DIA，将多酶消化样本多重进样到单次DIA采集，并在单一分析引擎内完成无谱库处理，实现蛋白变体（proteoform）分辨的单针蛋白质组学。
summary.methods: 多酶消化样本复用至单次DIA-MS注入，配套无谱库管线、proteoform推断算法与mE-DIA Peptide Mapper可视化；与基于DDA谱库的多酶DIA在同一原始数据和搜索空间下比较，并在化脓性链球菌三酶多重分析中评估。
summary.relevance: 摘要未涉及检索增强或对齐，与给定主题的直接关联不明确。
summary.caveat: 性能提升数据仅来自摘要所述特定比较；proteoform推断的假阳性率与跨平台可迁移性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Genome assembly and characterization of two Brazilian soybean cultivars contrasting for stink bug resistance
papers.abstract: Brazil's tropical soybean germplasm still has few genomic resources: only one assembly of a Brazilian cultivar is available at NCBI. Here we describe chromosome-level de novo assemblies of two contrasting cultivars: IAC-100, described as resistant to phytophagous stink bugs, and CD-215, susceptible. We sequenced high molecular weight DNA using 10x Genomics linked reads, assembled the reads with Supernova, anchored the assembly to the Williams 82 reference with RaGOO and corrected structural errors with REAPR. The assemblies span 1.057 and 1.061 Gb, with scaffold N50 values of 53.6 and 54.2 Mb (48.0 and 47.7 Mb excluding gaps), and recover more than 97% of conserved plant genes assessed by BUSCO. Homology-based projection of the reference protein-coding genes generated 46,774 and 46,620 gene models. Comparing the proteomes of the two cultivars, we identified 2,002 divergent isoforms in 1,427 loci, classified by sequence divergence, length variation, combined divergence and non-conserved homology. These data expand the genomic resources for tropical soybean germplasm, still underrepresented in public databases, and for studies of insect resistance.

summary.takeaway: 发布两个对比蝽类抗性的巴西大豆品种染色体级组装与基因模型，扩充热带种质基因组资源。
summary.methods: 10x Genomics linked reads测序，Supernova组装，RaGOO锚定到Williams 82参考，REAPR校正结构错误，BUSCO评估完整性，同源投影参考蛋白编码基因，并比较两品种蛋白组鉴定差异异构体。
summary.relevance: 摘要未提及检索增强或对齐，与给定主题无明确联系。
summary.caveat: 抗性表型与所鉴差异异构体之间的因果关系未在摘要中建立；基因模型来自同源投影而非独立注释证据。

papers.title: Ok-k-mer: Selecting k-mer length ensembles for calculating genomic distance
papers.abstract: Current methods for computing sequence similarity across large groups of genome sequences tend to do so at the level of k-mers since this is far more efficient than base-by-base alignment. While these methods use default k-mer lengths, recent work shows that the particular choice of k-mer length greatly affects accuracy, and that using multiple values of k can boost accuracy relative to the best single choice of k, particularly when the goal is to estimate genomic distances that reflect true phylogenetic relationships. Here, we introduce Ok-k-mer, a tool to systematically select weighted k-mer length ensembles for pairwise genomic distance estimation, thereby increasing the accuracy of those estimates. Given a phylogenetic tree, Ok-k-mer ranks genome pairs by Jaccard distance across a range of k and uses a progressive search to maximize the Spearman correlation, {rho}, between weighted-average k-mer ranks and branch distances. Across eight Genome Taxonomy Database datasets, Ok-k-mer ensembles improved correlation over standard default k-mer lengths. In the Chlamydiales taxonomy, a three-length ensemble k=(9,17,22) achieved a 23.9% relative improvement over the best single length (k=20) and a 36.7% improvement over a commonly used default of 31-mers. We demonstrate that Ok-k-mer k-mer length ensembles remain stable (i.e. lengths and weights change only moderately) under genome subsampling within a taxonomy but vary across datasets. Ok-k-mer can annotate all subtrees of a phylogeny, which reveals distinct patterns of ensembles reflecting potential differences in genome evolution. Ok-k-mer provides a framework for moving beyond a "one-k-fits-all" k-mer analysis, improving genomic distance estimation in the era of massive-scale genomics.

summary.takeaway: 提出Ok-k-mer，基于系统发育树系统选择加权k-mer长度集成，以提高基因组距离估计与真实系统发育关系的相关性。
summary.methods: 对一系列k值计算基因组对Jaccard距离排名，用渐进搜索最大化加权平均k-mer排名与分支距离的Spearman相关；在八个GTDB数据集评估，并分析子采样稳定性与子树注释。
summary.relevance: 摘要未涉及检索增强或对齐，与给定主题关联不明确。
summary.caveat: 方法依赖给定系统发育树作为监督信号；集成在不同数据集间变化，跨数据集泛化能力摘要中未充分说明。

papers.title: Dynamic regulation of single-cell contractile heterogeneity in the human trabecular meshwork
papers.abstract: Altered trabecular meshwork (TM) mechanics contribute to increased aqueous humor outflow resistance and elevated intraocular pressure in glaucoma, yet how contractility is regulated across individual TM cells remains poorly understood. Using a high-throughput single-cell contractility assay, we quantified time-resolved contractile behavior in primary human TM cells under defined extracellular matrix (ECM) compositions, substrate stiffnesses, and pharmacologic perturbations, and related functional mechanical behavior to intracellular protein abundance. Single-cell analyses revealed that TM contractility is not a uniform population property but a context-dependent contractile state shaped by both extracellular and intracellular regulation. ECM composition established distinct contractile programs, with collagen IV promoting rapid convergence toward a highly contractile state, collagen I supporting a slower but similar response, and fibronectin maintaining a persistently heterogeneous low-contractility state. In contrast, the intracellular perturbation dexamethasone (DEX) did not uniformly increase contractility but selectively prolonged contractile activity within the most mechanically active cells, thereby sustaining highly contractile states. This response was progressively constrained as ECM stiffness increased and was absent on pathologically stiff substrates, demonstrating that extracellular mechanical context conditions glucocorticoid responsiveness. Conversely, ROCK inhibition overrode both basal and DEX-induced contractile programs, collapsing the heterogeneous population into a uniformly low-contractility state. Finally, intracellular protein abundance poorly predicted functional mechanical behavior, with weak pooled associations reflecting divergent donor-specific relationships rather than consistent molecular-mechanical coupling. Together, these findings show that TM contractility emerges from integrating intrinsic cellular state and the extracellular mechanical environment rather than from either alone. More broadly, they identify single-cell contractile state as a functional dimension of TM cell identity that cannot be inferred from static molecular marker abundance or population-averaged mechanical measurements.

summary.takeaway: 高通量单细胞收缩性测定显示人小梁网细胞收缩性是由细胞外基质与细胞内调控共同塑造的情境依赖状态，而非均一群体属性。
summary.methods: 在定义ECM组成、基底刚度和药物扰动下，用高通量单细胞收缩性测定量化原代人TM细胞的时间分辨收缩行为，并与细胞内蛋白丰度关联。

summary.caveat: 细胞内蛋白丰度与功能力学行为关联较弱且供体间差异大；结果基于体外原代细胞，体内可推广性未在摘要中验证。

papers.title: Vertebrate paired fins are specified by an ancient dorso-ventral patterning system.
papers.abstract: The origin of paired fins was a major event in early vertebrate history that fueled the adaptive radiation of the gnathostome clade. Evidence for the conservation of ancient regulatory systems between paired and median fins supports a model in which appendage-patterning mechanisms first evolved in the midline and were later redeployed to a new embryonic context, the flank. However, while paired fins and limbs are asymmetric along the dorsoventral (DV) axis, the equivalent axis does not exist in median fins, which are symmetric across the midline, raising questions of how DV patterning evolved. Here, we combine genetic tools in zebrafish with comparative expression analyses in representative ray-finned and cartilaginous fishes to show that a subset of limb DV patterning genes are expressed during median fin development. Using genetic lineage tracing of the canonical limb dorsalizing factor lmx1bb, we further demonstrate that, although lmx1bb-derived cells occupy distinct spatial domains across fin types, a subset of this lineage is fated to differentiate into fin ray osteoblasts in both paired and median fins. To test the potential conservation of regulatory modules across fin types, we generated a series of deletion mutants for two known lmx1b mouse limb enhancers, LARM1 and LARM2, that we show are partially conserved upstream of zebrafish lmx1bb. These experiments revealed that LARM function is essential for dorsoventral patterning of the paired pectoral and pelvic fins of zebrafish but is dispensable for formation of the unpaired dorsal and anal fins. Collectively, these data support the conservation of an ancient LARM-Lmx1b dorsal determination system in the paired fins of osteichthyans, challenge models proposing simple co-option of a pre-existing median fin gene regulatory network and suggest that the acquisition of this regulatory module may have been a key early step in the evolution of the paired fin DV patterning axis.

summary.takeaway: 斑马鱼遗传学与跨鱼类比较表明，成对鳍的背腹图式由古老的LARM-Lmx1b系统指定，提示该调控模块的获得可能是成对鳍DV轴演化的重要早期步骤。
summary.methods: 结合斑马鱼遗传工具与辐鳍鱼、软骨鱼代表种的比较表达分析，对lmx1bb进行遗传谱系追踪，并构建两个小鼠肢体增强子LARM1/LARM2对应斑马鱼序列的缺失突变体。
summary.relevance: 涉及GRN/Regulon主题：通过增强子缺失与谱系追踪检验LARM-Lmx1b调控模块在不同鳍类型中的保守性与功能分工。
summary.caveat: 增强子功能在斑马鱼中部分保守，结论主要基于缺失突变表型；其他脊椎动物类群中的普遍性未在摘要中涵盖。

papers.title: Network inference at single-cell resolution reveals morphoregulatory divergence and multilayered buffering in limb evolution
papers.abstract: How changes in conserved developmental genetic programs contribute to morphological evolution remains poorly understood, particularly in non-conventional model species. Here, we combine single-cell transcriptomic and chromatin-accessibility profiling with cross-species label transfer and gene regulatory network inference to compare mouse and pig limb development. Our analyses identify broadly conserved cellular organization but discrete divergence in HOX-, FGF- and SHH-regulated programs. FGFR inhibition in mouse limb buds phenocopies the distal expansion of pig GREM1 expression, while altered SHH responses and anterior-posterior polarity converge on the PTCH1 regulatory landscape. Its functional dissection reveals degeneration of a limb regulatory module in artiodactyls, conservation of an additional distal enhancer, and extensive redundancy among cis-regulatory inputs. Allele-specific analyses further show that reduced Ptch1 dosage is buffered by transcriptional compensation. Together, these findings reveal how cis-regulatory and pathway-level robustness can accommodate distributed regulatory change while preserving developmental function, providing a mechanistic framework for the evolution of artiodactyl limb morphology.

summary.takeaway: 比较小鼠与猪肢体发育的单细胞转录组与染色质可及性并结合GRN推断，揭示HOX、FGF、SHH相关程序的离散分歧及多层缓冲机制。
summary.methods: 单细胞转录组与染色质可及性 profiling，跨物种标签转移与基因调控网络推断；在小鼠肢芽中进行FGFR抑制，并对PTCH1调控景观做功能解析与等位基因特异性分析。
summary.relevance: 直接相关GRN/Regulon：用单细胞网络推断与顺式调控元件功能解析比较物种间调控分歧与冗余缓冲。
summary.caveat: 跨物种标签转移与网络推断的可靠性受数据与注释限制；Ptch1剂量缓冲的机制证据主要来自摘要所述等位基因分析，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: AOPTK: Open-Source Software for AI-Assisted Toxicological Literature Analysis
papers.abstract: Motivation: Toxicologists today face a challenge: although vast amounts of data describing how chemicals affect human health are available across scientific publications and regulatory reports, much of this information remains underutilized because extracting and interpreting evidence across thousands of studies is impractical to perform manually. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly in large language models (LLMs), provide new opportunities to automate toxicological literature analysis. Results: Herein, we present the Adverse Outcome Pathway Toolkit (AOPTK), an open-source Python package for AI-enhanced analysis of toxicological and biomedical literature. AOPTK supports (i) automated literature retrieval from databases such as PubMed Central and Europe PMC, (ii) direct processing of full-text articles in PDF format, and (iii) LLM-assisted analysis tools to identify chemicals and extract their relationships to biological effects under user-defined conditions. We demonstrate its utilities through a case-study identifying potential non-genotoxic carcinogens based on their ability to inhibit gap junction intercellular communication (GJIC). The LLM-enhanced analysis achieves 81% agreement with an expert-curated inhibitor list and 95% accuracy in predicting inhibition versus no inhibition when analysing the same subset of 86 publications. Automated retrieval and analysis of 1 124 publications from PubMed Central further demonstrated the feasibility of applying AOPTK to large-scale literature analyses. Availability: The package is developed open source on GitHub, disseminated through PyPI and Bioconda and releases are archived on Zenodo. Individual tools are available in the Galaxy platform for accessible data analysis with user-friendly, findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable (FAIR) and end-to-end workflows provided via WorkflowHub. The tools are available on usegalaxy.eu and usegalaxy.cz and are developed open source on GitHub.

summary.takeaway: 发布开源Python包AOPTK，支持自动化文献检索、PDF全文处理与LLM辅助的化学品-生物效应关系抽取，并在非遗传毒性致癌物案例中展示可行性。
summary.methods: 集成PubMed Central与Europe PMC检索、PDF全文解析及LLM分析工具；以GJIC抑制识别潜在非遗传毒性致癌物的86篇文献子集为案例，并与专家整理列表比较。
summary.relevance: 相关大语言模型主题：展示LLM在毒理学文献证据抽取与大规模文献分析中的应用。
summary.caveat: 案例评估仅基于86篇文献子集与专家列表的一致性；大规模检索分析的准确性未在摘要中量化，LLM抽取的假阳性与可重复性仍需评估。

papers.title: Integrated omics analysis reveals reorganization of nitrogen and lipid metabolism in a toluene-degrading bacterium in the gas phase
papers.abstract: Gas-phase bioprocesses, in which microbial cells are immobilized on solid carriers exposed to the gas phase, enable efficient conversion of poorly water-soluble compounds for biodegradation and bioproduction. However, operation without a surrounding bulk aqueous medium can constrain the replenishment of water and nonvolatile nutrients. The metabolic mechanisms that sustain cellular activity in these low-water environments remain largely unknown. Here, we elucidated the metabolic alterations in the highly adhesive bacterium Acinetobacter sp. Tol 5 degrading toluene in the gas and aqueous phases. Polyurethane carriers bearing cells from independent cultures were assigned to the gas phase or to two aqueous media, nitrogen-depleted basal salt medium and phosphate-buffered saline, so that the conditions differed only in phase and nutrient availability. In cells actively degrading toluene, integrated metabolomics, lipidomics, and transcriptomics (97 metabolites, 108 lipids, and 3,899 genes) revealed a metabolic state specific to the gas phase. Under gas-phase conditions, amino acid and nucleotide degradation was enhanced while the intracellular glutamate pool was maintained at a high level, and citrulline specifically accumulated. Membrane lipids were remodeled, and the storage lipid triacylglycerol was consumed, suggesting that it serves as an endogenous carbon and energy source and may also contribute to metabolic water production under nutrient- and water-limited gas-phase conditions. These findings highlight nitrogen metabolism and lipid mobilization as features of gas-phase adaptation, providing a rational basis for designing robust gas-phase bioprocesses and selecting suitable microbial chassis.

summary.takeaway: 该研究通过整合多组学分析，揭示了Acinetobacter sp. Tol 5在气相降解甲苯时重组氮代谢与脂质代谢，表现为氨基酸和核苷酸降解增强、谷氨酸池维持高位、瓜氨酸积累及膜脂重塑与三酰甘油消耗。
summary.methods: 将负载独立培养细胞的聚氨酯载体置于气相、缺氮基础盐培养基和磷酸盐缓冲液三种条件下，对活跃降解甲苯的细胞开展代谢组学、脂质组学和转录组学整合分析（97种代谢物、108种脂质、3,899个基因）。
summary.relevance: 该研究属于多组学数据整合分析，与检索增强与对齐相关的跨模态特征对齐思路相近，可为异构组学数据的联合建模与条件特异性信号提取提供实验场景参考。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅基于单一菌株和甲苯降解场景，未报告统计显著性、重复数及与其他菌株或条件的验证；所提三酰甘油作为内源碳源和代谢水的推测尚需直接证据支持。
